family: All Boolean truth tables in dimensions 0 through 3, each prefix selector block; signed common literal branches; quadratic bent source spliced with its one-point flip

symmetry: No truth-table reduction. Prefix block covers every block up to physical coordinate permutation; exhaustive tables are invariant under that permutation. No claim of minimality.
arithmetic: Integer Walsh transforms, Fraction probabilities and influence; entropy identities as exact rational linear combinations of log2(prime); outward rational atanh-series logarithm bounds for inequalities
pilot: Full bounded domain is the pilot; no automatic escalation; stop on first failed assertion
independent_reproduction: Direct character sum versus FWHT on all n<=3; physical edge disagreement versus spectral influence on all cases. This is author verification, not independent agent acceptance.
